bootstrap.kind: moving-block bootstrap over test days (overlapping blocks, no wrap)

settings.independence_note: ARMOR3D is built from satellite observations and in-situ profiles, Argo among them, so it is not independent of the floats used here (GLORYS assimilates them too); OceanEmbed sees no in-situ data at prediction time, but is trained on GLORYS.

dataset.title: ARMOR3D REP - TSHUVMld Global Ocean Observation-based Product
dataset.regrid: vertical linear to the 15 standard depths, then 2x2 block mean (>= 50 % valid); no temporal interpolation
